name: tracked-changes-accept
title: Tracked Changes Accept
description: A paragraph with tracked insertions and deletions (like a legal review) plus per-change Accept/Reject controls — accepting morphs the text in place with a colour fade, rejecting strikes it out permanently.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Humanist
Color: Duotone

## Rules

- Per Change Accept: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
